## Interactive Shiny Applications

### Linear Models

::: {.arrow-list}

* **[Linearity Assumption](https://2j7s28-matteo-manente.shinyapps.io/lm-linearity-assumption/)**  
  Explore the relationship between predictors and outcomes and the assumption of linearity.

* **[Homoscedasticity Assumption](https://2j7s28-matteo-manente.shinyapps.io/lm-homoscedasticity-assumption/)**  
  Examine how constant and non-constant error variance affects linear regression.

* **[Outliers vs. Leverage](https://2j7s28-matteo-manente.shinyapps.io/lm-outlier-vs-leverage/)**  
  Explore the distinction between outliers and high-leverage observations in linear models.

:::
